# Dock FLIP capture/play omit windowId, routing to the first port

## Context

Booting a SharedWorkers dock workspace (private client repo) prints two warnings in the app worker before any interaction: `sendMessage destination "main" is deprecated. Use a windowId instead.` A race-free CDP attach (browser-level auto-attach, `waitForDebuggerOnStart`) captured the live argument previews: both are remote-method calls with `remoteClassName=Neo.main.addon.DockFlip`, `remoteMethod=captureFirst` / `play`, `destination=main`.

Live latest-open sweep: checked latest 20 open issues at 2026-08-30T22:15Z; no equivalent found. Prior art: #8149 migrated messaging to explicit window ids and introduced this deprecation; #8366 fixed the same class of warning for `registerRemote`.

## The Problem

`src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs` calls the FLIP addon without a `windowId`:

- line 1587: `flip?.captureFirst({hostId: host.id, markerPrefix: flipMarkerPrefix})`
- line 1654: `flip.play({hostId: host.id, markerPrefix: flipMarkerPrefix, geometryOnly: ...})`

`RemoteMethodAccess#generateRemote` swaps the destination to `data.windowId` only when the caller provides it; absent, the destination stays the deprecated `'main'` string and the SharedWorker port cascade falls through to the **last-resort first port** (`worker/Base.mjs#sendMessage` JSDoc).

Consequences by topology:

- **Single window (today):** works by accident — the first port IS the only window — plus two deprecation warnings on every boot, in every consumer's console.
- **Multi window (tear-out / popup roadmap, old cross-window drag demos):** the FLIP capture and play address the FIRST connected window's main thread, not the window whose DOM hosts the dock — a silent wrong-realm no-op at best.

## The Architectural Reality

`Neo.main.addon.DockFlip` is a per-window main-thread addon; its methods operate on THEIR window's DOM and read no `windowId` from data (grep receipt: no `windowId` in `src/main/addon/DockFlip.mjs`). The field is pure routing. The exact realm owning the captured markers is the dock host component's window — `host.windowId` — which `refreshDockWorkspace` already has in hand.

## The Fix

Add `windowId: host.windowId` to both payloads in `refreshDockWorkspace` (`src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs:1587` and `:1654`).

Decision Record impact: none (conforms to the routing contract #8149 established).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: both DockFlip payloads carry `windowId: host.windowId`; a unit spec on the workspace seam proves the payload shape (stubbed `Neo.main.addon.DockFlip` capturing call args).
- [ ] AC-2: booting a SharedWorkers dock app emits zero `destination "main" is deprecated` warnings from DockFlip calls — receipt from the CDP instrument or an equivalent browser-plane check.
- [ ] AC-3: full unit suite green in fully-parallel mode.

## Out of Scope

- Any DockFlip addon-side change — the addon is realm-correct once routing is.
- The deprecation warning mechanism itself (`worker/Base.mjs#sendMessage`), and other no-windowId callers outside the dock namespace (none fire on the observed boot path).

## Related

#8149 (windowId migration, prior art), #8366 (registerRemote precedent), #13158 (QT-parity docking epic), #17836 (v13.2 dock rebuild — the code's origin), #17885/#17891 (the client-workspace investigation this fell out of).
